row.title: A row read with a tab separator shifts when a field is empty, so retriage failed on every pass
row.body: scripts/retriage.sh read gh output with IFS tab, and bash collapses consecutive tabs, so a pull request with no labels moved the title into the updated field. Evidence, observed live: the fleet pass on 2026-11-28 printed date: invalid date and a syntax error at scripts/retriage.sh line 17. The rows are now joined with a vertical bar, a non-whitespace separator, so an empty field stays in place. Verified by bash -n scripts/retriage.sh and by a read of the same row with an empty label list.

title: A row read with a tab separator shifts when a field is empty, so retriage failed on every pass
